modules.title: 同一个 .js 文件，浏览器和 Node.js 各自怎样运行
Node.js 在整条工具链里的位置

items.title: 它是运行环境，不是一门新语言
items.text: 写的还是 JavaScript；Node.js 提供在电脑上执行它的能力，让脚本不打开浏览器也能运行。

items.title: 构建和包管理工具都依赖它
items.text: npm 和许多项目的构建命令会使用 Node.js；是否需要它要看项目工具链。本机缺少 Node.js 时，依赖它的命令会报 command not found。

items.title: 版本会被项目要求
items.text: 项目文档写 requires Node 18+ 时，用 node -v 查看本机版本；版本过低要升级后再运行。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Node.js 不替代浏览器：页面里的交互仍由浏览器执行。它补上的是“离开浏览器也能运行 JavaScript”这一块，命令行工具和服务端程序都靠它。

lessonPractice.title: 按项目文档运行 npm start，终端报 command not found: node。下一步怎么做？

options.label: 先安装 Node.js 并确认版本，再重试
options.feedback: 对。npm 自身运行在 Node.js 上，项目构建命令是否依赖它要看工具链；版本也要满足项目要求。

options.label: 把项目重新克隆一遍，再运行同样的命令
options.feedback: 报错说的是本机缺少 node 这个程序，与项目文件是否完整无关。

options.label: 改用浏览器打开项目入口文件来运行
options.feedback: 浏览器只运行页面里的脚本，不能替代项目需要的 Node.js 运行环境。

en.title: Following project docs, running npm start reports command not found: node. What should happen next?

options.label: Install Node.js, verify the version with node -v, then retry
options.feedback: Correct. npm runs on Node.js, and whether build commands depend on it varies by toolchain. The version also needs to meet the project requirement.

options.label: Re-clone the project and run the same command
options.feedback: The error says this machine lacks the node program; it has nothing to do with whether the project files are complete.

options.label: Open the project entry file in a browser to run it
options.feedback: A browser runs only page scripts; it cannot replace the Node.js runtime the project needs.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 终端提示 command not found: node。请先检查我本机有没有安装 Node.js、版本是多少；如果没装或版本低于项目要求，说明该装哪个版本，装好后重新运行项目命令并确认能正常启动。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The terminal reports command not found: node. First check whether Node.js is installed here and its version; if it is missing or below the project requirement, tell me which version to install, then rerun the project command and confirm it starts.

learning.assumes: You have heard of JavaScript and seen projects require an installed environment.
learning.outcome: You can recognize a missing or outdated node installation and use node -v to check whether the local version meets the project requirement.

modules.title: The same .js file, run by a browser and by Node.js
Where Node.js sits in the toolchain

items.title: It is a runtime, not a new language
items.text: You still write JavaScript. Node.js adds the ability to execute it on a computer, so scripts run without opening a browser.

items.title: Build and package tools depend on it
items.text: npm and many project build commands use Node.js; whether a project needs it depends on its toolchain. Commands that rely on a missing Node.js installation report command not found.

items.title: Projects require specific versions
items.text: When docs say requires Node 18+, run node -v to see the local version; upgrade before running if it is too low.

modules.title: What it does not replace
modules.text: Node.js does not replace the browser: in-page interactions still run there. It adds the ability to run JavaScript outside the browser, which command-line tools and server programs rely on.

distinctions.label: Browser
distinctions.text: A browser also runs JavaScript, but scripts live with the page and stop when it closes. Node.js runs independently in a terminal without opening a web page.

distinctions.label: npm
distinctions.text: npm is the tool that installs packages, and it runs on Node.js. When node reports command not found, installing Node.js comes before using npm.
